verdict.rationale: Proa documents its own first-party routing built into the framework. Routes are registered in `src/routes.rs` between generator-maintained markers, inspected with `proa site routes`, and configured through route specs that support page caching. Every render gets typed route state through the shared WebContext, which shows tight integration with the framework. missing for 10: documentation of routing features such as dynamic/nested params, layouts, and client-side navigation, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
